player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Kitchen and the Conservatory, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to move south from the Kitchen, which is not a valid move. Next time, I will pay closer attention to the available directions in each room and avoid making invalid moves. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also keep track of the rooms I have visited to avoid revisiting them unnecessarily.
